failure_summary.description: Several agents omitted a requested facet or used an endpoint that did not directly perform the requested action.
Agents lost or mis-mapped requested scope, hierarchy, filters, or canonical values.
Some agents added unrelated calls or fanned out to adjacent tools without a direct requested purpose.
Numeric values were inconsistently serialized, and one response was malformed and unparseable.

patch.reasoning: Most observed issues are already explicitly addressed by the skill, so duplicating those rules would not help. The broad-endpoint preference can, however, leave ambiguity when distinct requested facets have dedicated endpoints; this edit clarifies how to route those facets.

edits.target: For a broad request, prefer a documented broad or all-scope endpoint when it fully provides the requested output; do not choose a narrower endpoint merely because it has fewer required arguments.
edits.content: When a query requests distinct outputs and dedicated endpoints directly serve each facet (for example, current conditions and a multi-day forecast), use those purpose-specific endpoints rather than repeating a broad multi-capability endpoint with different parameters. Reuse the broad endpoint when it returns all requested outputs in one call or no directly fitting endpoint exists.
